title: Small Mobs
description: Turning Mobs into Action Figures with Action Packed Movements!
body:
This current project is a resourcepack meant to be used with **EMF**.

It is the very beginning of the current pack but I will be attempting to create a remodel and full animations for all mobs.

Each model will be redesigned to be similar to the common action figure. The animations will be sort of choppy, stop motion type of animation. I am debating on changing the texture of the models but that will be decided in the future.

With that, thank you for checking out this very early version of my pack. The name Small Mobs is inspired by the movie Small Soldiers.


~~Due to the limitations of CEM I cannot control the rotation of an entities entire body.~~
